items.content_html: This project is a classic Ping Pong game built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. The left paddle is controlled by the player using mouse movement. The right paddle is an AI opponent that follows the ball. The game includes scoring, ball bounce mechanics, and a dashed net for a retro look. Simple, lightweight, and playable directly in the browser.
